en: Sepia-toned historic view of a European city street lined with multi-story townhouses. Horse-drawn carts and a few pedestrians move along a gently curving cobbled street. The buildings have typical late 19th–early 20th century facades with tall windows and some ornamental details. At the top of the card is printed the caption identifying the location as Bahnhofstraße in Borna, near Leipzig.
